segments.text:
V. 51.
And ſhall allot him his portion with the hypocrites—The worſt of Sinners, as upright and ſincere as he was once!

If Miniſters are the Perſons here primarily intended, there is a peculiar Propriety in the Expreſſion. For no Hypocriſy can be baſer, than to call ourſelves Miniſters of Chriſt, while we are the Slaves of Avarice, Ambition, or Senſuality. Wherever ſuch are found, may GOD reform them by his Grace, or diſarm them of that Power and Influence, which they continually abuſe to his Diſhonour, and to their own aggravated Damnation!
